notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
description:
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {W} due to Zirda, causing an opponent and another player to each draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each opponent who drew a card this way, creating a Treasure token for each opponent that cannot pay for the trigger.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
